speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: Connecting the serving endpoint to monitoring is just the start, not the finish line. I need the system to automatically roll back to the last known good model if it detects a spike in forecast error during the morning order window.
output.correction: You are treating this as a passive logging task, but I am asking for an active feedback loop that can trigger a deployment action. The goal is to stop bad forecasts from hitting the store manager app, not just to record that they happened.
